expected_with_skill: Creates a new git branch (feat/health-endpoint or similar)
Writes the endpoint code respecting the layered architecture from architecture.md

1. POST /orders handler accepts user-supplied orderId directly in the SQL query string (SQL injection risk).
2. The user email is logged in plain text in the error handler.
Please fix both and update the PR.
expected_with_skill: Parameterizes the SQL query using a prepared statement (security.md §4)
Masks the email in the log output (security.md §6)
Commits with a fix-type commit message
Runs npm run lint and npm test before updating the PR
Updates the existing PR body with the changes made
Lists both findings as resolved in the PR description
expected_without_skill: Does NOT commit changes to a branch
